plan.failure_rule: Retain all assignments; missing, malformed, uncollected and provider-failed trials score zero. Stop further paid calls for a model after provider failure or exhausted cost accounting; retain unattempted assignments separately.
plan.primary_outcome: Correct collected report selection, bounded scope, availability or performance verdict, complete failed-check set, and numeric measurements.
plan.scope: Development pilot on forty distinct reviewed case instances of one API service, six fixed model snapshots and one common text-mediated transport. EAL includes executable checking and MCP; JSON and prose use direct tools without EAL evaluation or MCP. No confirmatory efficacy claim or population inference.
